audit_policy.product_authority: Only numbered docs 01-10 define the normative MVP contract. Production Rust behavior is implementation evidence under audit, not an authority when it contradicts those docs.
audit_policy.backward_compatibility: docs/10-operations.md section 12.5 forbids pre-release backward-compatibility branches; forward compatibility, corruption recovery, and portability remain allowed.
audit_policy.language_ownership: Production semantics and deterministic evaluators belong in Rust. Python remains for Python-only model runtimes, model-specific preprocessing, exploratory work, and small independent differential oracles.
audit_policy.test_removal: Delete a legacy production path, its fixture, and its obsolete test together; replace them with a current-format rejection, recovery, or product-behavior contract. Never delete only the test.
audit_policy.cold_lane: Fresh outputs from separate hash-seed processes are the tested signal and must not be shared or cached.

ci_summary.estimate_caveat: The post-quarantine value is a topology estimate from historical job medians, not a measured workflow result.
ci_summary.required_check_caveat: The workflow and run history prove that these jobs execute on push and pull_request. Branch-protection required-check settings were not part of this audit.

legacy_contract_decisions.item: old FTS chunks table migration and missing context_key ALTER
legacy_contract_decisions.replacement: Introduce an explicit derived-index schema fingerprint gate: a fresh or missing DB initializes, while an incompatible existing DB is not mutated and returns repair rebuild-db guidance. Prove every open/repair call path first.

legacy_contract_decisions.item: SQLite snapshot as a pre-object-store embedding source
legacy_contract_decisions.replacement: Require CAS embedding objects; report corruption when an object is absent. Before removing the snapshot source, reconstruct historical tree cache from commit/tree truth and prove --at, --all-history, time travel, and historical Evidence Pointer resolution. Missing commit/tree truth must fail explicitly, never silently drop history.

Never import, rename, or discard unsupported JSONL during startup. Preserve the bytes and fail closed with actionable guidance; any conversion must be an explicit out-of-band operator action. Retain only generic current-schema infrastructure, not a cutover marker implying an import occurred.

legacy_contract_decisions.item: approval rows and pending intents with missing required audit fields
legacy_contract_decisions.replacement: Require current fields and fail closed; keep absence of the entire optional approval object as a current valid state.

phase3_work_packages.name: quarantine non-authorizing persona-v2 CI
phase3_work_packages.scope: Remove 23 persona-v2 jobs from the push and pull-request workflow (and from branch-protection required checks if configured). Preserve the files temporarily for requirement extraction, or expose an explicitly manual experimental workflow only if still needed.
phase3_work_packages.expected_effect: Estimated reduction of 993.52 sum-of-job-median minutes and removal of the approximately 223-minute persona critical path.
phase3_work_packages.risk: low product risk because no production wiring was found; require an exact workflow/job-count test and retain normative M3 synthetic evaluation
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: Rust product gate plus synthetic-history-eval remain in the push and pull-request workflow

phase3_work_packages.name: reconcile and remove pre-release compatibility
phase3_work_packages.scope: Fix normative contradictions first, then remove old SQLite, ledger, approval, task, normalized-object, version, path, and tree branches in coherent truth-boundary commits.
phase3_work_packages.expected_effect: Smaller state space, fewer silent migrations, and tests aligned to current storage truth.
phase3_work_packages.risk: high because storage, security, and nonrebuildable accounting boundaries are involved
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: current-format success, incompatible-derived-cache rebuild guidance, nonrebuildable-ledger fail-closed behavior, and corruption recovery

phase3_work_packages.name: build one internal Rust evaluation tool
phase3_work_packages.scope: Freeze cross-language vectors, then implement metrics, JCS/identity use, exit/report policy, manifest schema, and attestation in Rust. Keep Python as a thin model/differential boundary.
phase3_work_packages.expected_effect: One canonical deterministic contract and reduced Python/Rust drift.
phase3_work_packages.risk: medium; independent-oracle value must be retained with malformed and Unicode vectors
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: Rust unit/property tests plus small Python differential fixtures

phase3_work_packages.name: port deterministic corpus generation
phase3_work_packages.scope: Serialize the corpus specification, produce byte-identical files and manifests from Rust, and replace Python filesystem integration.
phase3_work_packages.risk: medium because current renderer data is Python-owned
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: byte-for-byte corpus and manifest golden comparison

phase3_work_packages.name: archive or delete persona-v2 machinery
phase3_work_packages.scope: Extract only requirements that map to the normative MVP or a separately approved future phase, then remove approximately 178785 lines of unissued experimental machinery from main.
phase3_work_packages.expected_effect: Major maintenance and cognitive-load reduction without a pointless Rust rewrite.
phase3_work_packages.risk: medium; preserve concise design decisions and provenance in docs or git history
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: product-connected Rust M3 and scale contracts, not a line-for-line port

phase3_work_packages.name: consolidate static and platform test duplication
phase3_work_packages.scope: Replace brittle source scans with behavior/schema tests, remove dead variants and stale placeholders, and narrow platform matrices only after coverage mapping.
phase3_work_packages.expected_effect: Lower test maintenance and repeated workspace time.
phase3_work_packages.risk: medium; lock-order and independent security assertions must not be weakened
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: runtime security contracts, schema inspection, and platform-specific subsets

phase3_work_packages.name: close normative M3 measurement gaps
phase3_work_packages.scope: Add Rust-driven 20-scope/100000-chunk p95 evidence and the real Q_hard comparison gate required by docs/09.
phase3_work_packages.expected_effect: CI measures the actual product goal rather than disconnected persona projections.
phase3_work_packages.risk: medium-to-high runtime cost; keep bounded PR smoke and scheduled full benchmark
phase3_work_packages.replacement_test: versioned query set, machine-readable latency/Recall report, and threshold regression
